title: Screen Before You Add: Reducing Candidate Inference in Model Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2611.18647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As new models become available, existing ensembles must be updated to be competitive, making them intrinsically dynamic. Deciding whether to add a candidate model can require inference on an entire annotated dataset. Such a screening becomes prohibitive for models with costly inference especially when they ultimately add no value. Even under simple convex aggregation, relying on benchmark scores can be misleading as strong standalone performance does not guarantee ensemble improvement, and fitted ensemble weights can hurt test performance. In this work, we study candidate screening and show how early rejection can be achieved safely, exploiting residual geometry for stratification and rejecting the candidate when the best possible remaining predictions cannot achieve the necessary improvement. translated_title: 先筛选再添加：减少模型集成中的候选模型推理
translated_abstract: 随着新模型的不断涌现，现有集成模型必须持续更新以保持竞争力，这使其本质上具有动态性。决定是否添加某个候选模型可能需要对整个标注数据集进行推理，对于推理成本高昂的模型而言，这种筛选代价过高，尤其是当候选模型最终并不能带来价值时。即使在简单的凸聚合下，仅依赖基准测试分数也可能产生误导，因为强大的单独性能并不保证能提升集成效果，且拟合出的集成权重反而可能损害测试性能。在本工作中，我们研究候选模型的筛选问题，展示了如何安全地实现早期拒绝：利用残差几何进行分层，当剩余预测所能达到的最佳效果仍无法带来必要的改进时，即拒绝该候选模型。支撑这一方法的关键结论是：在凸聚合以及平方损失或Brier损失下，总体最优解得到改善当且仅当……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种利用残差几何进行分层的候选模型安全早期拒绝方法，在凸聚合和平方/Brier损失下，当候选模型即使在最优情况下也无法带来集成改进时即可提前拒绝，从而避免对候选模型进行全数据集的高成本推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a safe early-rejection screening method that exploits residual geometry for stratification, provably rejecting candidate models under convex aggregation with squared or Brier loss when they cannot possibly improve the population optimum, thereby avoiding costly full-dataset inference on candidates.
